query:
SELECT "id" AS "id!" FROM "Expense"
                WHERE ((?1 = 1 AND "archivedAt" IS NOT NULL)
                    OR (?1 = 0 AND "archivedAt" IS NULL))
                  AND (?2 IS NULL OR "frequency" = ?2)
                  AND (?3 IS NULL OR "isAutomatic" = ?3)
                ORDER BY "name" ASC
